records.title: UniSkip-Mamba: A Frequency-Aware State Space Model for Audio-Visual Temporal Forgery Localization
records.reason: Abstract: UniSkip-Mamba uses frequency-aware fusion/scan for AV forgery localization; 6x is specific to that detector.

records.title: Modular Foundation Models for Time-Series Perception in Digital Twins
records.reason: Abstract: digital-twin time-series representation, imputation/forecasting, and industrial temperature sensing.

records.title: MMViT: Bridging Mamba and Attention for efficient video action recognition in sports
records.reason: Title/abstract identify video sports action recognition, not language-model inference.

records.title: LASER: A Corrective Lens for LVLMs via Visual Attention Preservation and Sink Suppression
records.reason: The paper trains visual grounding behavior in LVLMs, but does not claim a compute, token, memory, or latency reduction; relation to visual-token inference acceleration is indirect.

records.title: Beyond Perplexity: A Behavioral Evaluation Framework for Deployment-Memory Claims in LLM Test-Time Training
records.reason: This is an evaluation framework for TTT memory claims, not an inference-memory or compute optimization; relation to the TTT lineage is methodological.
